what: Post-PR verification-run triggering is not bound to Python-selected kinds
scenario_or_breakage: Under `--kind python` (or a Python-only leg of `--kind all`), an implementer can gate `workflow_dispatch` / `_trigger_and_wait` on the harness leg only; Python verification then reads stale or empty logs and fail-closes (or passes on the wrong data) even though baseline packing succeeded
suggested_fix: In the Verification section and `rebalance.md`, state explicitly that after PR creation any selected leg that runs post-PR verification (harness, python, or both) shares one `n_verify_runs` workflow_dispatch loop before leg-specific collection; Python fail-closed checks run only after those runs complete
